//: claurdvoyant <-> Claude Code hooks. Merge the `hooks` block below into your ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope) or <project>/.claude/settings.json (project scope). Replace /path/to/... with absolute paths to your built binaries (cargo build --release puts them in target/release/). Hooks receive a JSON object on stdin with keys including session_id, transcript_path, cwd, and hook_event_name.

hooks.command: /path/to/cv ls --cwd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --limit 8 2>/dev/null; /path/to/cv board read "fleet" --limit 5 2>/dev/null; echo '(claurdvoyant: prior sessions + fleet board above; use the MCP recall/project_sessions tools for deeper context)'
CWD="$(jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"; /path/to/cv board post fleet "claude finished in ${CWD:-$PWD}" --from claude --kind status >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
